risk_note: RV2 (funds, read only). BR-WDR-18 asks to alert finance when W < 1.5 P and nothing did. The worker's /metrics exports couli_payout_water_low per app_id: 1 below the line, 0 not; an app with no W or one older than 2 hours has no sample, because 0 means checked and not low. The value comes from payout's read-only port and judgeWaterLevel, the judgement the fund ledger page uses, compared as integers. couli-fund.yaml adds one warning rule. It only alerts: EXECUTE's checks do not change. A failed read fails the scrape, never a 0. WatermarkReader's latest and forecast now take Kysely<DB> instead of Transaction<DB> so the port can read on a read-only handle; a Transaction is a Kysely, callers are unchanged. No write, no migration. Frozen test: [AC-B1-01zzi#6] in test/spec/platform/fund-metrics/rules.test.ts adds couli_payout_water_low to its allowed list and pins that a rule reads it, only additions (D10-327, ledger #2304). Alert routing: there is no Alertmanager configuration under infra/, as for every other rule of this file; finance gets this once the routing exists.

reviews.note: Independent Claude via claude-run.sh under approvals 36, because Codex was not logged in (401, orchestrator 18:34). couli-runs/B2-09j/money-review-r1.json, static, nothing executed. One S2, fixed after it: the alert description named only two of EXECUTE's refusals, and now names the usable share too; annotation text only, rule tests re-run, no second round.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude each round, static, not run by the reviewer. r1 fail with 2 S1 and 2 S2: every total was divisible by 7 and every P even, so P's rounding and a fractional 1.5 P were not pinned, nor a per-app read failure or an equal measured_at. A new independent Claude added #25 to #28, no assertion loosened. r2 on the increment pass, no findings. The implementer renamed the new helper kit.ts to water-harness.ts because the red check took it for the frozen file's ../metrics/kit.ts, and ran prettier on the test directory; imports and format only.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
